title: Dust or debris in the eye
scenario: Dust, grit, or a particle in the eye after collapse or demolition. Eye pain, watering, cannot see clearly.
steps: Do not rub. Blink several times and let tears work first.
Flush the eye with clean water for up to 15 minutes: tilt the head so water runs from the nose side outward.
Pull the upper lid over the lower lid briefly to help sweep the particle out.
If something is embedded or stuck in the eye: do NOT remove it. Cover both eyes loosely and call 911 or get emergency care.
For chemical splashes, flush continuously for 15 minutes and seek urgent care.
If pain, vision changes, or the feeling of something in the eye persists after flushing, seek medical care.
do_not: Never try to remove an object embedded in the eye.
Do not press on the eye.
